I implemented `fee(order)` in `/work/shipping.py`. The folder had no `shipping.py`, so I created a new one. I ran three cases.

- **Case with every rule applied** (jeju, 12 items, 5,001g, free-shipping threshold met, SHIP1000 coupon, gold member, Saturday, fragile, peak season): the function returned 10,660원. I worked it out by hand step by step and got the same number.
- **Simple case** (seoul, 1,000g, weekday): returned 2,500원.
- **Region not on the list**: raises `ValueError`.

There are no formal tests in this folder; I only ran these three cases by hand.

**Things I decided where the spec wasn't clear:**
- **"기본 요금 중 최저값" in step 4:** I read it as the lowest fee in the whole list, 2,500원. So jeju and ulleung get boxes × 2,500원 off. If you meant that island's own base fee, change `min(BASE_FEES.values())` to `base`.
- **Island fee going below 0:** after that discount I clamp the shipping fee at 0원, so it can't go negative.
- **Weekend check:** uses the order date (`date`).
- **Peak season:** December 20–31 of any year.

STATUS: DONE
